question.problem:
Given that $x,y\in {C}^{3},$ compute the standard Hermitian inner product $⟨x,y⟩$ of the following two vectors.

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}3+2i \\ 1-i \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,y=[\begin{aligned}2-i \\ 1+2i \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
Using the definition of the standard Hermitian inner product, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x,y⟩ & ={x}_{1}\overset{―}{{y}_{1}}+{x}_{2}\overset{―}{{y}_{2}}+{x}_{3}\overset{―}{{y}_{3}} \\  & =(3+2i)\cdot (\overset{―}{2-i})+(1-i)(\overset{―}{1+2\text{i}})+3\cdot \overset{―}{2} \\  & =(3+2i)\cdot (2+i)+(1-i)(1-2\text{i})+3\cdot 2 \\  & =(4+7i)+(-1-3\text{i})+6 \\  & =9+4i.\end{aligned}
$$
